title: Isandro and the Well
author: Mara Nakamura
blurb: Odile Lockridge, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in before the harvest moon rises.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
